summary_en: Tender offer price 1,580 yen/share. No price increase planned. Offer period ends 2026-08-03 (no extension unless required by law). Target board maintains recommendation for shareholders to tender.
title_en: Public tender offer for ordinary shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (securities code: 8141)
translation_en_brief: Kaga Electronics (the filer, 8154) commenced a public tender offer for ordinary shares of Shinko Shoji (8141, TSE Prime) on 2026-05-18. The offer price is 1,580 yen per share. This announcement reiterates that Kaga Electronics will not raise the tender price above this level, notwithstanding that Shinko Shoji's share price has temporarily traded above 1,580 yen since the offer began. Kaga Electronics characterizes 1,580 yen as the upper limit and final price it can offer while giving due consideration to Shinko Shoji's minority shareholders. The offer period is scheduled to close on 2026-08-03 and will not be extended absent a legal requirement. Shinko Shoji's board continues to recommend that shareholders tender into the offer.
